summary: Multi-agent (Planner, Finder, Skeptic, Reporter) investigation that links incidents across three police stations, with a deterministic evidence verifier that re-checks every ID, quotation and attribute the models cite.

sponsor_technology.name: Zetaris NDP
sponsor_technology.role: Federated SQL retrieval over five tables (live mode). In sample mode the same retrieval functions run over data/generated and are traced as local_sample, not Zetaris.

sponsor_technology.name: Meterless Nightshift + NVIDIA Nemotron
sponsor_technology.role: All model calls: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B (Planner, Finder, Reporter) and Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B A55B (Skeptic). In sample mode recorded live responses are replayed and labelled 'replayed'.

sponsor_technology.name: Meterless engines
sponsor_technology.role: H-MEM and Markovian run in the container from the open Apache-2.0 reference implementations (commit 1742dec, vendored unmodified in third_party/meterless). Scout Intent and World Model run only from a mounted Nightshift engine directory; otherwise they are traced engine_unavailable.

entry_point.compose: docker compose build && docker compose up

sample_mode.behaviour: Runs the real Planner/Finder/Skeptic/verifier/Reporter loop over data/generated with model responses replayed from data/sample/model_fixtures by prompt hash; a missing fixture runs a documented code-only fallback traced as code_fallback. Needs no network, credentials, Zetaris or Nightshift.

test_command: python -m pytest -q backend/tests && python -m pytest -q tests
limitations: Engines other than H-MEM/Markovian need the proprietary Nightshift engine directory mounted read-only (docker-compose.engine.yml).
Sample-mode answers are only as good as the recorded fixtures; prompts without a fixture use the weaker code-only fallback and are labelled.
Links are investigative leads, not findings of fact; scores are uncalibrated heuristics.
